Plot cell-phase rho by cell type

Source: R/plot_phase_rho.R
plot_phase_rho.Rd

This function plots circular concentration rho values from a scRhythmPhaseRho object returned by run_phase_rho().

Usage

plot_phase_rho(
  rho_res,
  group_colors = NULL,
  celltype_order = NULL,
  show_sig = TRUE,
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  point_size = 2.2,
  point_alpha = 0.85,
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

rho_res

A scRhythmPhaseRho object returned by run_phase_rho().

group_colors

A named character vector specifying colors for groups. If NULL, default scRhythmBayes group colors are used. Defaults to NULL.

celltype_order

A character vector specifying the order of cell types. If NULL, cell types are ordered by mean rho. Defaults to NULL.

show_sig

A logical value indicating whether significance labels should be displayed when sample-level significance results are available. Defaults to TRUE.

facet_scales

A character vector specifying facet scales for sample-level faceted boxplots. Defaults to "free_y".

point_size

A numeric value specifying point size. Defaults to 2.2.

point_alpha

A numeric value specifying point transparency. Defaults to 0.85.

title

A character vector specifying the plot title. If NULL, no title is shown. Defaults to NULL.

Value

Invisibly returns a list containing:

plot

The ggplot object.

data

The plotting data.

sig

The significance-label data, if available.

mode

The plotting mode, either "sample_boxplot" or "group_dotplot".

params

Plotting parameters used by the function.

Details

If sample-level rho results are available, the function draws boxplots across samples within each cell type. If no sample-level results are available, the function draws a group-level dot plot with one rho value per cell type and group. Group-level rho plots are descriptive only and do not support statistical testing.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

rho_res <- run_phase_rho(
  res_phase = res_phase,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "condition",
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  group_levels = c("A", "B"),
  min_cell = 10,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

p_rho <- plot_phase_rho(rho_res)
p_rho$plot
} # }
